name: Acmella

project_scope.admission_note: A. repens approved for learner; target-zone range UNRESOLVED.

shared_genus_characters.look_here_first: Check opposite leaves at a trailing node and then dissect the head for the chaffy conical receptacle and fruit.
shared_genus_characters.shared: Herbs with pedunculate heads, yellowish disk florets and paleate receptacles; fruit and node characters matter more than ray color.

local_lookalike_cautions: Eclipta prostrata: opposite leaves but usually white rays; check receptacle and fruits.
Synedrella nodiflora: different head placement and cypsela architecture.
Sphagneticola trilobata: commonly lobed leaves and larger rays.
